Every read here resolves the caller's visible SOURCES first — a pharmacist sees pharmacy invoices, the accountant sees all of them — and hands that set to the service, which applies it in the QUERY. Never as a default for a `?sourceType=` the caller passed: a filter the client controls is not a boundary.
